hypothesis: FCLR-H003: funding + price features improve out-of-sample forecasts of the FULL predictive distribution of next-24h realized variance (quantile forecasts) beyond an RV-only HAR baseline.
target: next-24h realized variance (continuous) as a predictive distribution
quantile_estimation: train-only linear quantile regression (Hunter-Lange MM/IRLS); never re-fit on test
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp; 7-day (168h) purge/embargo at train/val and val/test boundaries; test -> 3 interleaved blocks

models.B1: linear quantile regression on log RV1h/RV24h/RV168h (HAR)
models.C2: B1 + signed funding(24h) + trailing 90d |funding| percentile + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired test-set average pinball loss across the five quantiles
inference: >=2000 deterministic moving-block bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); report average + per-quantile pinball, empirical coverage, 95% CI, per-block, leave-one-symbol-out
decision_rule: PROMOTED iff relative average-pinball reduction >=2% AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND test data sufficient; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if test data insufficient
